description: This Swift source file defines a final class `DevicePairingApprovalPrompter` responsible for managing device pairing requests, presenting alerts, handling user responses, and communicating with a backend gateway for device pairing approval or rejection. It utilizes asynchronous tasks, logging, and observation patterns within a macOS application context.

classes.name: DevicePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class managing device pairing approval prompts, handling incoming requests, user interactions, and coordinating with backend services.

classes.name: PairingList
classes.description: A Codable struct representing the lists of pending and paired devices.

classes.name: PairedDevice
classes.description: A Codable and Equatable struct representing a device that has been paired, including its device ID, approval timestamp, display name, platform, and remote IP.

classes.name: PendingRequest
classes.description: A Codable, Equatable, and Identifiable struct representing a pending device pairing request with details such as request ID, device info, client info, scope, remote IP, and flags.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the pairing prompter by starting the push task to listen for pairing events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the pairing prompter, cancels ongoing tasks, clears states, and resets counters.

methods.name: startPushTask
methods.description: Begins listening for incoming pairing push notifications, managing associated tasks.

methods.name: stopPushTask
methods.description: Stops listening for push notifications, cancels tasks, and resets alert states.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches pending device pairing requests from the backend gateway.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a received list of pairing requests, updates the queue, counts, and presentation flow.

methods.name: updatePendingCounts
methods.description: Updates counters for total pending requests and repair-specific pending requests.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks conditions and presents the next pairing alert if applicable.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays a device pairing request alert to the user with details and response handlers.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Processes user response from the alert; approves, rejects, or reorders requests accordingly.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sends an approval for a device pairing request to the backend.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Sends a rejection for a device pairing request to the backend.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push events related to device pairing requests and resolutions.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new pending request to the queue if not already present, then updates counts and presentation.

methods.name: handleResolved
methods.description: Processes a pairing resolution event, updating the queue and alert state accordingly.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Constructs a detailed description string for a pairing request to be shown in the alert.
